race.title: Get A Free Trial Of Racing TV Now Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but it could be worth siding with Dan Skelton's SERVICE MINIMUM who has returned better than ever over hurdles and now has her first go over fences. She Is For Me Boys rates just the pick of the weights of those with chasing experience and is next on the list. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR) SHE IS FOR ME BOYS BEST WOMEN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Dream Shadow (7/4), Service Minimum (4/1), Bobbi's Beauty (5/1), Kalista Love (6/1), She Is For Me Boys (7/1), Best Women (7/1)
